name: Scary Love
source:
You are a normal person with a normal job in a normal house. You work in a flower shop and your boss, a sweet cornflower, has just had a small accident, so her nephew will come to replace her.

Oh what a surprise it's your old schoolmate, Kyler!

He is so happy

.

.

.

T̶o̶o̶ ̶̶h̶a̶p̶p̶y̶

[From [url=https://parrotlover.itch.io/scary-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个普通人，住在普通的房子里，做着一份普通的工作。你在一家花店上班，你的老板——一朵温柔甜美的矢车菊——刚刚出了一点小意外，于是她的外甥将来替她的班。

噢，真是太惊喜了，来人竟然是你的老同学凯勒！

他好开心啊

。

。

。

开̶心̶得̶过̶头̶了̶

[引自[url=https://parrotlover.itch.io/scary-love]Itch.io[/url]]
